title: nolan — a walkthrough that describes itself
$comment: The self-describing hero. It drives the bundled toy app while the narration tells nolan's actual story — agents showing (not telling), generated per recipient, delivered in the voice of the business — and cycles through every caption look as it goes. The opening greeting uses a {{who}} variable to make the 'personal to whoever's watching' point literal. Film in post with --style=examples/showcase.style.json so karaoke and pill highlights animate.

beats.text: Hey {{who}}, here's a quick look. Made just for you.
An agent wrote this walkthrough from a short spec.
If the app changes and this breaks, your build fails first.
Soon it speaks in your brand's voice, word for word.
Made personal for whoever is watching.
Styled to fade back, or to stand out. Your call.
A new spec for each person. Your voice, every time.
That's it. Your voice, and it made itself.
